# m.stocks.short_interest

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Short interest of US-listed stocks, one row per ticker and FINRA settlement date.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.stocks.short_interest(symbols=None, *, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol` and `SettlementDate`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Stock tickers; leave it out for every ticker. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first settlement date. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last settlement date. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any of Massive's field names, such as `"settlement_date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. A watchlist's `fetch()` caps every request instead. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"days_to_cover_gte": 5}`. Keys: `avg_daily_volume`, `avg_daily_volume_any_of`, `avg_daily_volume_gt`, `avg_daily_volume_gte`, `avg_daily_volume_lt`, `avg_daily_volume_lte`, `days_to_cover`, `days_to_cover_any_of`, `days_to_cover_gt`, `days_to_cover_gte`, `days_to_cover_lt`, `days_to_cover_lte`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Short Interest (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated every 2 weeks, 2 years |
| Stocks Starter | Updated every 2 weeks, All history |
| Stocks Developer | Updated every 2 weeks, All history |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated every 2 weeks, All history |
| Stocks Business | Updated every 2 weeks, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "The primary ticker symbol for the stock." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. When `MassiveConfig.unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, such a row fails the table instead, and the column is absent. |
| `AvgDailyVolume` | long | The average daily trading volume for the stock over a specified period, typically used to contextualize short interest. |
| `DaysToCover` | double | Calculated as short_interest divided by avg_daily_volume, representing the estimated number of days it would take to cover all short positions based on average trading volume. |
| `SettlementDate` | String | The date (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD) on which the short interest data is considered settled, typically based on exchange reporting schedules. |
| `ShortInterest` | long | The total number of shares that have been sold short but have not yet been covered or closed out. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
